MOLIAE Beauty Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions Amendment:

  • Google Ads Restriction: Affiliates are strictly prohibited from running Google Ads, paid search campaigns, or search engine marketing (SEM) utilizing brand-related keywords, trademarks, or direct domain traffic.

  • Commission Ineligibility: Any sales generated through paid search ads or where Google Ads is identified as the traffic source will not be eligible for commission payouts.

  • Duplication & Internal Control: This restriction is enforced due to MOLIAE Beauty's internal multi-channel marketing and direct-media initiatives, preventing attribution duplication and ensuring distinct separation between brand-managed campaigns and affiliate traffic.

  • Enforcement: Clicks or conversions originating from unauthorized paid search traffic will be automatically rejected, and persistent violations may result in immediate termination from the affiliate program.
